page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-4-lssd is a general-purpose server instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 CPU architecture. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This instance does not include GPU accelerators, local storage, or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on an ARM-based architecture, this instance type offers a resource-efficient profile for workloads that benefit from ARM instruction sets. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the multi-tenant resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. However, the lack of integrated local storage and GPU hardware limits its utility for data-intensive storage operations or accelerated graphical and machine learning workloads.

The c4a-standard-4-lssd is suited for general-purpose applications, including web serving, microservices, containerized deployments, and lightweight application servers. It is also appropriate for software development and testing environments optimized for ARM64 environments.
